+# Language parsing boundary
+
+The hosted indexer registers native tree-sitter grammars for Go, JavaScript,
+TypeScript, TSX, Python, Ruby, Rust, Java, C, C++, C#, and PHP, with a small
+shebang fallback. Parser errors, unregistered grammars, and unknown text formats
+fall back to explicit bounded line windows. Inputs over one MiB and binary
+content are rejected before a parser sees them.
+
+Parsing extracts data only. It does not load repository plugins, compilers,
+language servers, package managers, or other repository-controlled programs.

explanations.summary: Files are classified by extension, with special handling for Gemfile/Rakefile and a small set of shebangs. Unrecognized files are treated as unknown and use the fallback path.

explanations.title: Bounds parsing and adds fallback windows
explanations.summary: Parsing now rejects inputs above the configured byte limit and content containing NUL bytes. Unsupported languages or parser failures produce bounded line-window nodes instead; window size and count have defaults and can be configured.

explanations.summary: The default registry wires native tree-sitter parsers for the supported languages and returns declaration nodes, including their kind, name, and source range, where available.
